patterns.note: The page uses a full-width layout with content centered within a maximum width, creating ample whitespace around key information.
Headings utilize a very large, bold sans-serif font for high impact, contrasting with smaller, lighter weight sans-serif for body text and small uppercase for navigation and labels.
A cool color palette dominates, featuring a gradient of blues for the hero and CTAs, paired with a very light off-white for section backgrounds and dark navy/gray for primary text.

The hero background image (mountains and sky) exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls down the page. The navigation bar becomes sticky at the top after initial scroll.
Key content elements, such as the product video mockup and subsequent feature sections, are revealed with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The FAQ section employs an accordion design, allowing users to click to expand answers, which helps manage content density.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion system, use CSS keyframes for the hero background parallax effect, making it scroll at a slower rate than the main content. Implement a sticky navigation bar that activates after a certain scroll threshold. Utilize JavaScript or CSS animations to trigger fade-in and subtle slide-up effects for content sections and the product video mockup as they become visible in the viewport.

The hero section features a full-bleed background with a gradient blue sky and a subtle mountain illustration, over which large, centered text and a call-to-action button are placed for immediate impact.
Call-to-action buttons are designed with a subtle blue gradient fill and soft rounded corners, providing a clear visual target and a modern aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and UI elements, conveying a soft, modern feel without being overly playful.
design_tokens.spacing: The design features airy spacing in the hero section for a grand, open feel, transitioning to a balanced density in content and FAQ sections for readability.

standout: The site's distinctive hero section, featuring a subtle, ethereal mountain illustration with a gradient sky and a parallax scroll effect, immediately sets a unique and sophisticated tone. The seamless integration of a realistic product video mockup directly below the hero text, revealed on scroll, is also a standout feature for demonstrating functionality elegantly.
